title: Sum diagonals of a matrix
description: Given a 3x3 square matrix, compute the sum of the main and secondary diagonals.
solutionExplanation: Main diagonal: [i][i]. Secondary: [i][n-1-i]. A single loop.

title: Selection Sort
description: Implement selection sort: on each pass find the minimum and put it in its position.
hints: Outer loop i from 0 to n-2
solutionExplanation: Selection Sort: O(n²) comparisons, O(n) swaps.

title: Product of 2x2 matrices
description: Multiply two 2x2 matrices using three nested loops.
hints: For each C[i][j], add A[i][k] * B[k][j]
solutionExplanation: Matrix product: C[i][j] = sum of A[i][k] * B[k][j]. Three nested loops.
